apps.name: Tuna
apps.subtitle: Your music at home.
apps.localizedDescription: Your music from your Tuna server, with mixes and lyrics. Download songs to play offline.

versions.localizedDescription:
Fixed
- Songs said "nobody on Soulseek has it" when plenty of people did (Ultralight Beam, say). slskd says a search is done a moment before it has saved what came back, longer on a Raspberry Pi, and Tuna read it too soon. It now waits until everything is there.
- Songs with several artists from Exportify ("Kanye West, Chance the Rapper, …") were searched with all of them at once, and Soulseek found nothing. Now with the main artist.

New
- Albums Lidarr knows from Deezer (Tubifarry's Deezer metadata source, if you turn it on) can be got too, with their covers; MusicBrainz's version is still used when both have an album. Without it, nothing changes.

To update: the server (pull the new image); the apps don't need updating.
